propositions: rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md incorrectly instructs running plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation, before dependency links exist and regardless of blocked state.
The plan-review gate fast-fails with exit 2 (INDETERMINATE, no LLM) on blocked tickets still open with unclosed dependencies, making premature review wasteful and guaranteed to fail.
Plan-review must run in dependency order (prerequisites/children before dependents) after the dependency graph is established, only on unblocked tickets identified via rebar ready.
rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md must specify a fallback: if rebar ready returns an empty set, diagnose and resolve dependency graph cycles or authoring errors before proceeding.
rebar-implement/SKILL.md already correctly treats the dependency graph as a precondition and uses rebar ready/next-batch to claim and review only the unblocked, dependency-ordered set.
